name: 16_water_plant
title: Watering Plant and Rearranging Table
summary: The robot waters a potted plant, sets the watering can down, temporarily moves the plant behind the chair, adjusts the watering can, and returns the plant to the table.
robot: one robotic arm with a two-finger parallel gripper
setting: an office or dining space with a white marble table and a white chair

source.original_prompt: pour water into the potted plant

segments.instruction: Lift the grey watering can and position its spout directly over the potted plant while the camera remains stationary.
Tilt the watering can forward to water the plant, then tilt it back upright while the camera stays fixed.
Move the watering can back to the right side of the table, place it down, and release the handle.
Move the gripper over to the potted plant and grasp the rim of the pot.
Lift the potted plant, move it behind the solid backrest of the chair out of view, and set it down.
segments.memory_event: hide: potted plant is lowered behind the chair backrest and hidden from camera view

segments.instruction: Return the empty arm to the table, grasp the watering can handle, and rotate the can slightly clockwise.
Release the watering can and reach behind the chair backrest toward the object placed there earlier.
Lift what was placed behind the chair back onto the table, setting it down in its original location.
segments.memory_event: return: the potted plant reappears from behind the chair unchanged and is placed back on the table
